gloss: club member; team member; department staff

definitions.gloss: club member; team member; department staff
definitions.explanation: A member of a {部|ぶ} — either a school/university club ({文化部|ぶんかぶ}, {運動部|うんどうぶ}) or, in a company, a member of a department ({営業部|えいぎょうぶ}, {人事部|じんじぶ}). Context determines which sense applies, but the school-club usage is by far the most common in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部員|ぶいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The tennis club is recruiting members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部員|ぶいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Ten new members joined the club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{部員|ぶいん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The club president listened to all the members' opinions before deciding on a policy.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (club, department, division) + {員|いん} (member). The senior member who leads the ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ is the ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧.

USAGE:
- School/university: {部員|ぶいん} = a member of a club such as ⟦{野球|やきゅう}{部|ぶ}→野球部：27441_yakyuubu⟧, ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}{部|ぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧, etc.
- Workplace: {部員|ぶいん} = a member of a department, e.g. ⟦{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部員|ぶいん} (sales department staff)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部員|ぶいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recruit club members
- ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧{部員|ぶいん}: new club member
- {部員|ぶいん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all the members
- {部員|ぶいん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of members

SIMILAR / RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧: member — broader, casual; covers any kind of group
- ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧: club president / department head — leader of the ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: member (of an association or organization) — used for ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧, not ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧
